title: Meet the Professor session on the MSK-KP
summary: A recent webinar presented by the American Society for Bone and Mineral Research (ASBMR) included a "Meet the Professor" session focusing on research questions that can be investigated using the MSK-KP.
bodyHtml: A recent webinar presented by the American Society for Bone and Mineral Research (ASBMR) included a "Meet the Professor" session focusing on research questions that can be investigated using the MSK-KP. If you missed it, you can watch the recording here.
